hook: This boat was sinking with four crew still on it.
narration: This fishing boat was going down, and four crew were still on it.
The Kupreanof was in the Gulf of Alaska, near Lituya Bay.
Waves were already breaking across the deck.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk from Air Station Sitka was overhead.
The crew got their life raft into the water beside the boat.
[short pause] As the boat rolled further, they clung to the rail and the boom.
In seas like this, the hoist operator talks the pilot in over the target, foot by foot.
They made it into the raft, and the boat went under beside them.
outcome: The Jayhawk crew hoisted all four and flew them safely to Sitka.
title: Fishing boat sinks with 4 crew aboard
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station Sitka MH-60 Jayhawk crew hoisted the four crew of the sinking fishing vessel Kupreanof in the Gulf of Alaska near Lituya Bay, Alaska, on June 10, 2015.
